Passed on final documents and evidence; /private/tmp/t063-docs-final.log and /private/tmp/t063-safety-final.log. Both repositories pass git diff --check.

coverage: Schema 8 additive migration, immutable full envelopes and definitions, exact metrics, evaluator/normalization identity, separately bounded typed samples and explicit inspection warnings.

Exact input certificate keys include alias/version/artifact/consumer, AST/resolved null/severity/sample policy, evaluator/semantics and normalization. Changed keys miss, force/cancellation refuse, original PASS/WARN outcomes and evaluation times remain unchanged with a separate reuse occurrence.

Samples default off. Explicit allowlist excludes sensitive fields. Caps cover 20 rows, 16 scalar columns, 4096-byte cells and 64 KiB stored payloads. Decimal/u64/ns/binary/bool/NaN cells retain exact types; complete counts are independent.

Failed candidates remain retention roots without dataset version/head visibility. Gate and publication failures retain diagnostic identity; normal evidence and worker logs contain no failed row payloads.
Real lifecycle qualification asserts all completed checks are durable, provider PASS evidence survives consumer failures, and canceled/conflicting candidates are inspectable without publication.
test_notes: Initial verification caught stale contract-registry hashes, a migration-count assertion and the shared-corpus count assertion; all updated to reviewed schema 8 / 250-case inputs.

Overlapping qualification runs exposed fixture startup timing: one evaluator deadline fired before the injected query began, and one existing cancellation test did not observe worker readiness. The synthetic evaluator deadline was increased from 1 to 3 seconds while retaining the assertion that the expensive query starts. The orphaned synthetic cancellation worker was identity-checked and terminated. Final suites run independently.
limits: Public build dispatch, terminal state composition and selection of certificate reuse remain T064. Current single-attempt lifecycle actually evaluates every check.
Explicit diagnostic inspection is an internal service API. No UI/export/OpenLineage endpoint is claimed. Non-attributable dataset checks return an empty sample reason; nested fields are omitted.
Failed-candidate roots remain retained pending a future explicit evidence-retention policy. Caller retains runtime ownership, verified environment and exact input leases.
Runtime SQLite schema advances 7 to 8; protocol 1.0, AST 1, specification 1.1.2 and dependency/toolchain pins remain unchanged.
T062 CI is owner-confirmed in t062-ci.json. T061 CI remains unconfirmed. T063 push CI remains with the owner; no workflows polled.
